progress.message: Re-loading the exported GLB and checking skeleton, clips and events

request: Bare Knuckle Lunatic: Brawler who thinks every problem is a fistfight. Always bouncing, always throwing punches. He holds nothing (fists always closed); keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Attack
animations.description: Three-punch combo: left jab, left jab, then a huge wind-up right haymaker. The haymaker connects at the 'hit' event.

animations.name: OH_Death
animations.description: His death ability: knocked to one knee, raises his right fist high and SLAMS it into the ground (event 'shockwave' at the moment of impact - the game sends the knock-back wave), then collapses forward and stays down (do not return to idle).
